status: PRE-REGISTERED confirmatory run of docs/13 amendment A3, hypothesis H8.9 (memory: the model can be pruned at little cost). Validation split only; the test split is never loaded.
same_as: experiments/cvtm/configs/cvtm_a3_H8_9.json: identical variants, thresholds, estimator and checks (that config was never run); compute.peak_gib is the measured 16 GiB bound instead of the 24 GiB estimate (compute.peak_note)
docs: docs/11 sections 11.2 to 11.7; docs/12 F19 and F20 (b) residues, (c) pooled EM, (d) pruning estimator; docs/13 amendment A3
seeds: none: the CVTM-core is deterministic given the data (docs/13 A3); uncertainty is the document-block bootstrap

data.byte_accounting: total negative log2-likelihood of the validation subword stream / UTF-8 bytes of the validation text (1,145,547), protocol CP
data.dataset_hashes: protocol.write_dataset_hashes(('train', 'validation')): tok and doc_start of both splits, validation text and doc_bytes, as results/20260923T042350Z_CP_anchor/dataset_hashes.json plus the document boundaries

frozen.note: the frozen CVTM-core of lane L0 (docs/11 11.6 on the full V 8000 train split, whole-document window, components S, D0..D4, P); the stage-1 files must still carry these sha256 (checked at start)

bootstrap.statistic: per resample: sum of bits / sum of UTF-8 bytes of the drawn documents (paired: of the differences)
bootstrap.label: derived

hypothesis: CVTM-core with n-gram types of count 1 removed at orders 3 to 5, then count at most 2; model bytes vs validation bits per byte

thresholds.text: a variant at no more than 30 percent of the unpruned bytes loses at most 0.02 bits per byte (docs/13 A3 H8.9)

variants.name: prune_c1
variants.meaning: types of raw count 1 removed at orders 3 to 5

variants.name: prune_c2
variants.meaning: types of raw count at most 2 removed at orders 3 to 5

params.estimator: docs/12 F20 d: kn_gpu.fit_kn(..., prune_cont='full', prune_mass='backoff'); CVTMCore.fit(min_counts=...) prunes BOTH KN fits (without H and on all documents), so the EM sees the estimator that is scored
params.model_bytes: SuffixClauses.nbytes() (the scoring arrays: own votes plus keys, docs/12 F20 d)
params.unpruned_reference: the frozen core (bytes and validation value; the value must equal the frozen 1.240880320113308)
params.loss: variant minus unpruned CVTM-core validation bits per byte, paired document-block bootstrap
params.secondary_rows: KN-5 alone over each pruned base (the variant with components S)

compute.peak_note: 16 GiB = measured peak RSS of a driver process of this lane that ran the same full-split CVTMCore.fit, 12.50 GiB (VmHWM, results/20260924T150704Z_cvtm_a3_H8_8a/, fits at 5M, 20M, 67M and the full split plus validation scoring), and 11.12 GiB for loading the frozen core and scoring validation (results/20260924T102203Z_cvtm_a3_H8_2/, results/20260924T102454Z_cvtm_a3_H8_7/), plus a margin of about 3.5 GiB. The earlier 24 GiB was an estimate from the L0 cache build, whose driver also held the cache-writing callbacks. The memory rule itself is unchanged (memory.current + peak < 0.80 memory.max, poll every 2 minutes); memory.current counts page cache of other lanes' files (about 51 GiB of the 60 GiB at 15:28 UTC), so the 24 GiB bound kept a run waiting inside the exclusive GPU lock.
compute.memory_rule: before loading the frozen core and before each fit: memory.current + 16 GiB < 0.80 memory.max, else wait (poll 2 minutes, handing the shared GPU lock to a waiting exclusive job at every poll); fits one at a time; mem_guard at its default limit

launch: scripts/gpu_run.sh shared -- scripts/cpu_slot.sh 1 -- nice -n 10 .venv-tm/bin/python scripts/mem_guard.py -- scripts/run_logged.py --name cvtm_a3_H8_9 --config experiments/cvtm/configs/cvtm_a3_H8_9_yield.json -- .venv-tm/bin/python -u experiments/cvtm_a3_rows_yield.py --config experiments/cvtm/configs/cvtm_a3_H8_9_yield.json
launcher_note: run through experiments/cvtm_a3_rows_yield.py, which imports experiments/cvtm_a3_rows.py unchanged and only hands the SHARED GPU lock to a waiting exclusive job at idle points (before each fit, at every memory-rule poll, before each validation scoring call; tmlm.common.locks.yield_gpu_if_requested). No number, check or threshold changes; every yield is logged in the metric gpu_lock.yields. Reason: the GPU-lock lesson of the lane A1 resume (2026-09-24): a shared job holding the lock through CPU-only phases blocked an exclusive energy run for 20 minutes.
